mechanism: Cursor discovers installed skills and presents them to the agent. The agent decides relevance from the description and loads SKILL.md with its read tools. That load does not have to be the first tool call. Setting disable-model-invocation true is what limits a skill to an explicit slash command. These skills do not set that flag. A system event with no selected skill is compatible with that path.
